title: Auto-Top-Off Water and Leak Watch
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), vivarium climate (`vivarium:climate`), fish feeder (`fishfeeder:event`), auto-doser (`doser:event`), auto-top-off (`ato:event`), pond sensors (`pondsensor:reading`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium controllers — reef-tank parameter monitors, auto-dosers, auto-top-off, reptile terrarium climate/UVB, and pond sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs (e.g. Apex, GHL, ESPHome).
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ato:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(topup_ml) as topped, count as cycles by _time
| eventstats avg(topped) as usual
| eval abnormal=if(topped>usual*2,1,0)
description: Watches how much water the auto-top-off adds each day, flagging a spike that can mean a leak or runaway evaporation.
value: A sudden jump in top-off volume is often the first sign of a leak or a stuck valve, caught here before the floor gets wet.
implementation: Ingest top-off events into `index=personal`; schedule daily and alert on abnormal top-off volume.
visualization: Column chart of daily top-off volume with a normal band.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how much water is automatically added to the tank, warning of a leak if it suddenly needs much more.
